purpose: Teach: セクシー/グッド/軍団/不気味/嗜好/バリバリ/アイスランド/死な

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の彼女、セクシーだぜ
lines.style: Teasing lilt on the open. Eyes alight with mischief. Quick delivery, daring him to react. Light jab energy — not mean, just testing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストで「グッド」評価もらったろ?桜
lines.en: You got a 'good' on your test, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet turn-around, caught her off-guard. Gentle point — almost kind. Slight hesitation before her name, like he's choosing his moment.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ヒーロー軍団のフィギュア集めてるな
lines.en: You're collecting those hero-squad figures, aren't you.
lines.style: Soft observation, half-smile in the voice. Not accusatory — noticing something true about him. Matter-of-fact, like she sees through the cool.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、深夜の通学路、不気味じゃね?桜
lines.en: Doesn't the late-night walk to school feel a little eerie to you?
lines.style: Genuine question, leaning in. Quiet concern underneath the casual ask. Testing whether she feels what he feels about that stretch of road.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の音楽嗜好、お洒落だぜ
lines.en: Your music taste is actually pretty cool.
lines.style: Sincere compliment wrapped in teasing tone. Slight surprise in her own voice — admitting something true. Not too soft, just honest.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、最近バリバリ勉強してんな、桜
lines.en: You've been hitting the books pretty hard lately, haven't you.
lines.style: Quiet approval, almost proud. No edge to it. The kind of thing you say when you've been watching someone struggle and then suddenly they're doing it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、アイスランドの自然見たいよな
lines.en: You want to see Iceland's nature, don't you.
lines.style: Eager opening, slight upward lift. Excitement for him — knowing what matters. Quick, bright, leaning forward in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ゾンビ映画、絶対死なずに最後まで生き残るキャラ好きだろ、桜
lines.en: In zombie movies, you always root for the character who somehow makes it to the end, right.
lines.style: Knowing smile in the delivery. Close, intimate observation — catching him in something he didn't know he'd shown. Warm and precise.
